about.title: About Khai Nguyen Air Compressor
about.visionText: To become the leading provider in Southern Vietnam for comprehensive, high-quality, and energy-saving air compressor solutions, helping clients optimize their production capacity.
about.valuesText: Dedication - Quality - Speed. We always prioritize our clients' interests and strive to deliver the best repair services and parts on the market.
about.historyText: Established to meet the urgent demand for screw air compressor repair in Dong Nai and Binh Duong industrial zones. Through 15+ years of growth, Khai Nguyen has built an experienced team of engineers and a rich inventory of spare parts, ready to serve 24/7.

repair.title: Professional Air Compressor Repair Services
repair.intro: The screw air compressor system acts as the 'heart' supplying energy to the factory's production line. Khai Nguyen provides 24/7 professional emergency repair services to resolve issues in the shortest time.
repair.emergencyDesc: Technical team responds on-site within 2 - 4 hours of receiving calls in Dong Nai, Binh Duong, HCMC, and Long An.
repair.genuineDesc: Committed to using genuine or high-quality equivalent oil filters, air filters, lubricants, and spare parts with long-term warranty.

consulting.title: Standard Compressed Air System Design Consulting
consulting.intro: Power consumption of air compressors accounts for 70% - 80% of their total lifecycle cost. Proper engine room and pipeline network design optimizes energy costs and extends system lifetime.
consulting.auditDesc: Using specialized flow meters and ultrasonic leak detectors to evaluate the actual wastage of compressed air in your factory.
consulting.savingDesc: Providing smart alternating control options and inverter upgrades to maximize energy control and eliminate wastage.
